regions.label: INesHeader
regions.evidence: iNES header: NES^Z, 8x16KiB PRG, 0 CHR (CHR-RAM), flags $21 = mapper 2, vertical mirroring.

regions.label: TileGfx_Bank0
regions.evidence: Tile pattern data (2bpp, 16 bytes/tile) uploaded to CHR-RAM by LoadTileSet $C51B: descriptor lists at $C97C-$CAEC (via pointer table $C87A) give bank=hi>>6, addr=(hi&$3F)|$80, count (0=256); copy loop $C58F reads ($04,X) -> $2007 and wraps into next bank at $C000. Union of all 127 descriptor extents covers this range; observed CPU reads in S0-S7 fall only inside these extents (8160 distinct offsets here).

regions.label: Bank4MapLayout
regions.evidence: Round 2 typed split of round-1 generic data (lead L-004; redirect r1-a1 extent proof analysis/redirect/r1-a1/l004_extents.json, re-checked by analysis/evidence/round-2-disassembly/tools/apply_r2.py). Map layout: one 32x32 block id per byte, 64 bytes per 256-pixel page (DrawMapBlock $F7AA area: address $8000 + MapIndex with bank 4 selected). 57 pages; extent ends at the first block-attribute base $8E40 (BlockAttrBaseLo/HiTbl $F866/$F86A). Max block id per page group 0-17/18-33/34-49/50-56 = 219/126/123/89 = attribute/definition set size - 1. Bank 4 data (never executed; data-only bank context).

regions.label: PaletteTable
regions.evidence: Palette records: LoadPalettes $C2D9 selects bank 4 and copies 4 bytes from $BC00+id*4 (id from $06D1-$06D4) to PPU $3F00/$3F10; id is a byte so the table spans $BC00-$BFFF (256 x 4). 192 offsets read in S0-S7.

regions.label: Bank5CollisionMap
regions.evidence: Round 2 typed split of round-1 generic data (lead L-004; redirect r1-a1 extent proof analysis/redirect/r1-a1/l004_extents.json, re-checked by analysis/evidence/round-2-disassembly/tools/apply_r2.py). Collision map read by GetTerrain (bank 5 selected, address $8000 + (page*256+x)/4 | y-band): 64 bytes per page, four 2-bit cells per byte; 57 pages as in the bank-4 map layout, followed by zeros. Bank 5 data (never executed; data-only bank context).

regions.label: MsprFramePtrTbl
regions.evidence: Round 2 typed split of round-1 generic data (lead L-007; redirect r1-a1 extent proof analysis/redirect/r1-a1/l004_extents.json, re-checked by analysis/evidence/round-2-disassembly/tools/apply_r2.py). Metasprite frame pointer table (MSPR_FRAME_PTR_TBL): 256 little-endian words, one per ObjFrame, read by DrawMetasprite with bank 6 mapped; all targets in $8200-$90CA. Bank 6 data (never executed; data-only bank context).
